meta.title: Game launcher
meta.description: Open App hosting from the left sidebar; the Game card at the top of that page starts and stops the local sandbox game (Godot) without a terminal and run.sh. The card always shows Open game and Stop game and disables the inapplicable one: Stop is unavailable while the game is not running, Open is unavailable while it is. Stopping needs a second confirming click so the game is not closed by accident. The state refreshes every five seconds and, besides the processes this plugin started, scans the process table for this project's Godot binary, so a game started from a terminal or play.command is detected and can be stopped too (editor windows are excluded so unsaved scenes are not lost); externally started games are marked Started outside. The start page opens by default (choose solo or online), and the game window runs independently of DSH and stays open after DSH quits. Stopping asks the game to quit before force-terminating its whole process group after four seconds. The App hosting plugin (@local/app-host) must be enabled. The plugin registers same-origin-only local endpoints under /api/game-launcher/* and does not read or upload any game data.
